topic: {由紀|ゆき} vents about her boss
title_jp: {聞いて|きいて}！{腹立つ|はらたつ}！
context: Sunday 29 November, evening: アルちゃん is at the shopping-street supermarket when {由紀|ゆき} messages from {東京|とうきょう}, furious that her boss praised a senior colleague for her idea.
scene: Sunday evening at the supermarket. {由紀|ゆき} messages you, really angry about her boss. Time to react like a good friend.

phrases.jp: {部長|ぶちょう|department head|3}は{私|わたし}に{対して|たいして}だけ{厳しい|きびしい|strict, harsh|4}。
phrases.en: My boss is strict only with me.
phrases.note: Person + に{対|たい}して = towards that person.

phrases.en: What, no way! Isn't that awful?
phrases.note: ひどくない？ = 'isn't it awful?', asking for agreement, not a negative.

phrases.jp: それは{怒って|おこって}{当然|とうぜん|natural, of course|3}だよ。
phrases.en: You've every right to be angry.
phrases.note: 〜て{当然|とうぜん} = it's only natural that… Shows you're on their side.

phrases.jp: {話したら|はなしたら}、ちょっとスッキリした。
phrases.en: Talking about it made me feel a bit better.
phrases.note: スッキリ = refreshed, a weight off your chest.

phrases.jp: {一回|いっかい}、{深呼吸|しんこきゅう|deep breath|3}しよ？
phrases.note: しよ？ = しよう？, soft and friendly. Calming someone down.

dialogue_setting: LINE, Sunday evening. You're in the supermarket queue; {由紀|ゆき} is at home in {東京|とうきょう}.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: アル〜{聞いて|きいて}！マジで{腹が立つ|はらがたつ|to get angry|4}
dialogue.en: アル~ listen! I'm seriously angry.
dialogue.note: マジで = {本当|ほんとう}に.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: {企画|きかく|project, proposal|3}、{私|わたし}が{考えた|かんがえた}のに{部長|ぶちょう|department head|3}が{先輩|せんぱい|senior colleague|4}を{褒めた|ほめた|to praise|3}の
dialogue.en: I came up with the project, but my boss praised my senior colleague.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.en: What, no way! Isn't that awful?

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: しかも{部長|ぶちょう}、{男性|だんせい|man, male|3}に{対して|たいして}は{優しい|やさしい}のに、{私|わたし}に{対して|たいして}は{厳しい|きびしい|strict, harsh|4}んだよね
dialogue.en: And my boss is nice to the men, but strict with me.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: マジか…それは{怒って|おこって}{当然|とうぜん|natural, of course|3}だよ
dialogue.en: Seriously… you've every right to be angry.
dialogue.note: マジか = {本当|ほんとう}か, 'seriously?'.

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: ありがと。{話したら|はなしたら}、ちょっと{スッキリ||refreshed, relieved|4}した〜
dialogue.en: Thanks. Talking about it made me feel a bit better~

dialogue.speaker: 由紀
dialogue.jp: てか、{対決|たいけつ|showdown|3}どうだった？{結果|けっか}{聞いて|きいて}ないじゃん！
dialogue.en: Anyway, how did the showdown go? You never told me the result!
dialogue.note: てか = というか, 'anyway, by the way'.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: 4{対|たい}6で{負けた|まけた}ｗ　{次|つぎ}は{絶対|ぜったい|definitely, absolutely|4}{勝つ|かつ|to win|4}！
dialogue.en: Lost 4 to 6 lol. Next time I'll definitely win!

listening.intro: Meanwhile, an announcement comes over the supermarket speakers.
listening.title: スーパーのお{知らせ|しらせ}
listening.place: The shopping-street supermarket, {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}

lines.jp: ご{来店|らいてん|coming to the shop|2}ありがとうございます。ただいまより、りんごを{全品|ぜんぴん|all items|2}2{割引|わりびき}いたします。
lines.en: Thank you for shopping with us. From now, all apples are 20% off.

lines.jp: {日曜日|にちようび}だけのサービスです。どうぞご{利用|りよう}ください。
lines.en: It's a Sunday-only offer. Please take advantage of it.

listening.question: {何|なに}が{安く|やすく}なりますか。
listening.explain: りんごを{全品|ぜんぴん}2{割引|わりびき}: every apple is 20% off, today only.

grammar.form: noun + に{対|たい}して ({私|わたし}に{対|たい}して, お{客|きゃく}さんに{対|たい}して) · before a noun: noun + に{対|たい}する + noun ({私|わたし}に{対|たい}する{態度|たいど}) · contrast: 〜のに{対|たい}して ({兄|あに}は{静|しず}かなのに{対|たい}して)
grammar.explanation: Marks who an attitude or action is aimed at: お{客|きゃく}さんに{対|たい}して{丁寧|ていねい}. With の it contrasts two things. Don't mix it with について, which is the topic you talk about, not a target.

examples.jp: {健太|けんた}はお{客|きゃく}さんに{対して|たいして}、いつも{丁寧|ていねい|polite|4}だ。
examples.en: {健太|けんた} is always polite to guests.

examples.jp: {兄|あに}は{静か|しずか}なのに{対して|たいして}、{弟|おとうと}はよく{話す|はなす}。
examples.en: My older brother is quiet, whereas my younger brother talks a lot.

quiz.question: {先生|せんせい}は{生徒|せいと}＿＿、とても{優しい|やさしい}。
quiz.en: The teacher is very kind to the students.
quiz.explain: The students are the target of the kindness → に{対|たい}して. について would be 'about the students'.

quiz_more.question: お{客|きゃく}さん＿＿{態度|たいど|attitude|3}が{悪い|わるい}{店員|てんいん}がいた。
quiz_more.en: There was a shop assistant with a bad attitude towards customers.
quiz_more.explain: Before a noun ({態度|たいど}) use に{対|たい}する.

quiz_more.question: {東京|とうきょう}は{人|ひと}が{多い|おおい}＿＿、{鷹ノ原|たかのはら}は{静か|しずか}だ。
quiz_more.en: {東京|とうきょう} has lots of people, whereas {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} is quiet.
quiz_more.explain: Contrasting two clauses needs の first: {多|おお}いのに{対|たい}して.

kanji.where: On your lock screen while you queue: 「LINE: {新|あたら}しい通知が3{件|けん}」.
kanji.breakdown: {通知|つうち}: 通 pass through + 知 know → 'pass on so someone knows': notify.
kanji.related: {通知|つうち}をオフにする = mute notifications. {知|し}らせ = a notice.

tip.title: Agree first, advise later
tip.body: When a Japanese friend vents, they usually want {共感|きょうかん} (empathy), not solutions. React first: わかる, ひどい, それな, {当然|とうぜん}だよ. Advice too early can sound like you're taking the other side.

challenge.prompt: {由紀|ゆき}: 「{健太|けんた}くんって、どんな{人|ひと}？」 Tell her he's really polite to guests, but mean to you (as a joke).
challenge.model_answer: お{客|きゃく}さんに{対して|たいして}はすごく{丁寧|ていねい|polite|4}だけど、{僕|ぼく}に{対して|たいして}は{意地悪|いじわる|mean, teasing|3}だよｗ
pieces: お{客|きゃく}さんに{対|たい}しては
すごく{丁寧|ていねい}だけど、
challenge.explanation: Each に{対|たい}しては names who the attitude is aimed at, and は sets the two people side by side for the contrast. だけど links the two halves. Plain form and ｗ fit a chat with {由紀|ゆき}.
challenge.hint: 〜に{対|たい}しては … だけど、〜に{対|たい}しては …

vocab.note: Literally 'the belly stands up'. Casual: {腹立|はらた}つ！
Also club captain at school. People call their boss {部長|ぶちょう}, not by name.
Anyone who joined before you. The opposite is {後輩|こうはい}.
{褒|ほ}められる = to be praised. Common answer: いえいえ、そんな…
Strict people, rules, or weather: {厳|きび}しい{寒|さむ}さ.
〜て{当然|とうぜん} = it's only natural that…
After venting, a shower, a tidy room. Also written すっきり.
{絶対|ぜったい}{勝|か}つ = I'll definitely win. With negatives: never.
Opposite: {負|ま}ける. Particle に: {健太|けんた}に{勝|か}つ.

kanji_study.parts: 文 on the left + 寸 a hand on the right → two sides facing each other, hand to hand: opposite, versus.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 村 (village): 村 has 木 tree on the left, 対 has 文.

kanji_study.parts: 月 body (flesh radical) + 关 two hands lifting + 力 power → lifting with all your body's strength: win.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 券 (ticket): 券 has 刀 at the bottom and no 月 on the left.

extras.title: Reacting on LINE
extras.intro: Short reactions friends use all the time.

items.en: I know, right / I get it
items.note: The most common empathy word. Long ー sounds warmer.
Slang: ｗｗｗ looks like grass ({草|くさ}).

items.jp: {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}？{無理|むり}しないでね
items.note: Comforting someone who is tired or stressed.

extras.title: Angry, from mild to furious
extras.intro: From a little annoyed to really angry.

items.note: Small, ongoing annoyance: traffic, a slow queue.
Casual, a bit rude. Don't use it about your boss at work.
Slang. {部長|ぶちょう}がキレた = the boss blew up.
